title: Never Left Behind
story:
A class of children visited a large museum.

Before they entered, the teacher said,

“Stay close, and if you get worried, look for me.”

As they walked through the exhibits, one little boy stopped to admire a display.

When he looked up, the group had moved on.

He felt frightened.

He thought he had been left behind.

Just then, he heard a familiar voice.

The teacher had noticed he was missing and had come back for him.

She smiled and held out her hand.

“I told you I would look after you.”

The boy's fear disappeared as they walked back together.

Life can sometimes make us feel forgotten.

But God never loses sight of His children.

He does not abandon those who belong to Him.

His faithful love always brings us safely into His care.
life_lesson: No matter where you are or how you feel, God will never abandon those who belong to Him.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for never leaving me.

When I feel alone or forgotten, remind me that You are always near.

Help me to trust in Your faithful love and to rest in Your promises.

Thank You for holding me securely in Your care.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt forgotten or left behind?

How does God's promise to never forsake you bring comfort today?

How can you encourage someone else with this truth?
verse:
For the Lord will not reject His people;
He will never forsake His inheritance.
